items.title: 17.2 AC ke liye mean power aur maximum power ka relation (talluq) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.2 and Example 17.2 (PDF 89-90).

blocks.text: Alternating current woh current hai jo baar baar apni direction (simt) ulat'ta hai, is liye voltage aur current sine wave ki tarah upar neeche hote rehte hain. Resistive load woh hai jo energy store (jama) nahi karta (jaise capacitor ya inductor karte hain) balke seedha heat (garmi) ki shakal mein kharch (dissipate) kar deta hai.

blocks.title: Instantaneous power
blocks.text: Kisi bhi instant (lamha) t par circuit mein jo power ho, woh instantaneous power P hai.

Yahan V us instant ka voltage aur I us instant ka current hai. Sab se zyada (peak) power Pₘₐₓ tab hoti hai jab current aur voltage dono apni peak qeemat Iₒ aur Vₒ par hon. Mean power Pₘₑₐₙ AC waveform ki ek poori cycle ki average power hai (Fig. 17.4).

blocks.alt: Power P aur waqt ka graph: orange lakeer zero se dashed lakeer VoIo tak jati hai (maximum power, peak value), wapas zero par aati aur repeat hoti hai, kabhi zero se neeche nahi jati. Doosri dashed lakeer (1/2) VoIo par mean power hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.4: Mean power maximum power ki theek aadhi hai (kitab ki Figure 17.4 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 17.4 mein VₒIₒ wali lakeer ki taraf do teer hain: 'Peak value' aur 'Peak voltage'. VₒIₒ power ki peak hai, voltage ki nahi; is liye drawing mein 'Peak voltage' nahi likha. Power P = VI hamesha positive rehti hai kyunke V aur I ek saath direction badalte hain, aur is ki average peak ki aadhi, ½VₒIₒ, hai.
Sine wave wale AC mein Iₒ current ki peak qeemat aur Vₒ voltage ki peak qeemat ho to sab se zyada power:

blocks.text_alt: Eq. 17.7 se Iᵣₘₛ²R = Pₘₑₐₙ, is liye

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan IR²ᵣₘₛ chhapti hai. Sahi Iᵣₘₛ²R = Pₘₑₐₙ hai (Eq. 17.7): square current par hai, R par nahi.

Yani resistive load mein sine wave wale AC ki mean power, maximum power ki aadhi hoti hai. Wajah yeh hai ke instantaneous power waqt ke saath badalti hai: cycle ke kuch points par maximum hoti hai lekin kaafi waqt zero ya kam qeemat par rehti hai, is liye average peak ka aadha banta hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Kitab digital clamp meter ki tasveer dikhati hai, jo AC aur DC naapta hai. Is ka clamp (jabra) taar ke gird band ho kar current ka magnetic field mehsoos karta hai, is liye circuit kaatna nahi parta.

blocks.title: Example 17.2
blocks.problem: 50 Ω ke resistor par 220 V ka alternating voltage lagaya gaya hai. System ki mean power kilowatt mein nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: R = 50 Ω aur V = 220 V (kitab is 220 V ko peak qeemat le rahi hai).
Qeematen rakhein: Pₘₐₓ = (220 V)²/50 Ω = 48400/50 W = 968 W
Mean power, peak power ki aadhi hai: Pₘₑₐₙ = Pₘₐₓ/2 = 968 W/2

blocks.title: Peak ya rms?
blocks.text: Ghar ki bijli ka voltage (220 V) aam taur par rms qeemat hoti hai. Agar is sawal ka 220 V rms ho to mean power = Vᵣₘₛ²/R = (220 V)²/50 Ω = 968 W hogi aur peak power 1936 W. Kitab ne 220 V ko peak maan kar hal kiya hai.

blocks.title: Fascinating Fact (hairat angez baat)
blocks.text: Scientists ne insani blood sugar (khoon ki shakkar) ko bijli mein badal diya hai.

blocks.prompt: AC circuit mein ek resistor ki peak power 200 W hai. Is ki mean power kitni hai?
